Ghar par banaen bajar jaise svadisht aur khubsurat kaju pista rol yah Kaju Pista Roll Recipe banane men aasan aur khane men behad lajvab hai. agar aapko Kaju Katli, Kaju Roll aur Dry Fruit Sweets pasand hain, to yah Homemade Kaju Pista Roll Recipe jarur traee karen. tyoharon aur khas maukon ke lie ek behatrin Indian Sweet Recipe.
Ingredients for Kaju-Pista Rolls
Kaju - Cashews - 1 cup (150g)
Pista - Pistachios - ⅓ cup (30g)
Badam - Almonds - ⅓ cup (30g)
Pisi chini - Sugar Powder - 2 tbsp (20g)
Ilaichi paudar - Cardamom Powder - ¼ tsp
Dudh - Milk - 2 tsp
